inspections.violation_description: School-based child care program fails to provide complete written safety plan at time of inspection.

violations.description: School-based child care program fails to provide complete written safety plan at time of inspection.
Child Medical record are DOHMH property when health care provider provided by DOHMH
Written safety plan describes provisions for health care maintenance and compliance; provisions for emergency medical care first aid and CPR
Person in charge of school prohibits staff from attending in absence of immunization documentation
Written safety plan describes provisions for supervision during general and off site activities
All staff who will have unsupervised contact with children has undergone child abuse and criminal justice screening and reference checks

inspections.violation_description: Children enrolled in school-based child care program have Not received periodic medical examination.

violations.description: Children enrolled in school-based child care program have Not received periodic medical examination.
Each staff member has documentation showing they received 2 doses measles/mumps vaccine, 1 dose rubella vaccine, 2 doses varicella vaccine and 1 dose Tdap

Teaching and supervisory staff trained in infection control, reporting of infectious diseases, administration of medication, handling/storage of hazardous materials, general safety, and transportation. New staff trained within 3 months of hire

Teaching and supervisory staff trained in abuse/maltreatment identification and reporting. 2 hours of training received every 24 months. Training provided by OCFS approved trainer. New staff trained within 3 months of hire
